description:
The future of defense will be decided by those who field intelligent machines at scale. At Scout AI, we’re developing Fury, the first robotic foundation model for defense, to give U.S. forces overwhelming, adaptable, and autonomous power across every domain. Fury enables human operators to command fleets of robots through natural language, and empowers those machines to sense, decide, and act together as one. This mission will ask everything of us: urgency, precision, and relentless work.

 The Role 
 We’re looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to design and build the software that powers intelligent robotic systems. You’ll work on perception, autonomy, control systems, and infrastructure that allow robots to operate reliably in complex environments. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving real-world problems at the intersection of robotics, AI, and scalable software systems. Your work will run on robots in complex, adversarial environments. Expect to move fast, test ideas aggressively, and break new ground as we create the first robotic foundation model for defense. We’re a startup. You’ll be moving fast, context-switching daily, and helping define the culture and process as we go. This is a rare opportunity to come in early and architect the future of defense. 

 Responsibilities 

 
 Design and deploy software for advanced drone hardware, promoting autonomous flight capabilities and delivery operations

 Develop software for robotic perception, planning, and control

 Develop dynamic memory, communication, and tool use faculties for AI agents

 Build and maintain robotics infrastructure, simulation, and testing environments

 Integrate sensors such as cameras, LiDAR, and IMUs into robotic systems

 Implement and optimize algorithms for localization, mapping, and navigation

 Work on autonomy pipelines from perception to action

 Collaborate with hardware, AI, and product teams to ship robotic capabilities

 Improve system reliability, performance, and real-world robustness

 Contribute to deployment and monitoring of robotic systems in production environments

 
 Qualifications 

 
 Strong programming skills in C++, Python, or similar languages

 Experience developing robotics systems or autonomy software

 Experience working with real-world robotics hardware or simulation environments

 Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills

 Ability to work across multiple layers of the robotics stack

 Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

 Passion about defense of the United States and its allies

 May be expected to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance

 
 Why Join Scout 

 
 Work on the world’s most important frontier, ensuring U.S. and allied dominance in the age of intelligent machines

 Be a core part of a team building the first defense-specific robotic foundation model

 Collaborate with some of the top engineers in autonomy, AI, and national security

 See your work deployed on real systems

 Help define the future of intelligent defense systems

 Backed by Draper Associates, Booz Allen Ventures, and other top investors

 
 Benefits 

 
 Competitive base salary and bonus

 Meaningful equity

 Premium medical, dental, and vision plans with $0 paycheck contribution

 Competitive PTO and company holiday calendar

 Catered lunch daily and fully stocked kitchen

 EV charging

 Relocation assistance (depending on role eligibility)

 The stated salary range below represents an estimated base pay only and reflects consideration of multiple compensation factors. Final salary offers may differ depending on factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience or training background, specialized skills, and business needs. Most full-time positions also include highly competitive equity awards, which form part of Scout AI's overall compensation package. In addition, Scout AI provides comprehensive, top-tier benefits to full-time employees.

 US Salary Range
 $145,000 — $220,000 USD
